_about: The SOCOM 16 nerf (the owner, 2026-10-25: "Nerf SOCOM: 10 damage, 5 penetration" and "move SOCOM to lvl 15"; docs/notes/socom_nerf.md). wpn_socom16, the game's only SOCOM: bullet_damage 0.7 -> 0.6 and bullet_pierce 0.45 -> 0.4 (10 and 5 off in the lobby card's units, x100; f32 kept), the card's prop 1 (damage) 70 -> 60 and prop 3 (armour piercing) 45 -> 40; item_level and match_making_level 12 -> 15 (the card's "Equipment level", the drop tier, the matchmaking level and the craft and reroll prices; the two are equal in every 0.26g item). Its distance falloff (min_damage_amount 0.6 from 30 m to 100 m) stays: it scales the new numbers. After weapon-balance-2, whose 0.8 -> 0.7 it starts from.
